results.content: ## Cosmos Scholarship Network's Post. & Ph.D. Positions Available in Graph Neural Network (GNN) & Graph Foundation Model (GFM) Research! We are looking for highly motivated M.Sc. and Ph.D. students to join our research on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev (BGU). This is an exciting opportunity to work on theoretical and applied deep learning, focusing on advancing the fundamental understanding and capabilities of GNNs and GFMs. Theoretical foundations of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) – scalable, adaptable, and explainable graph-based AI. Spectral and combinatorial perspectives on graph-based learning. We seek students with strong mathematical and computational backgrounds eager to tackle open research challenges in Graph Learning and Graph Foundation Models. ✔ Experience in deep learning and GNNs (academic projects/industry). ➕ Experience with Graph Foundation Models (GFMs), geometric deep learning, graph signal processing, representation learning. Let’s push the boundaries of Graph Neural Networks and Graph Foundation Models together!
